'''Bestine sea anemones''' were likely marine cnidarians indigenous of the planet [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine IV]]. The flabby, pale, fingerlike growths of [[Xabar]] fungus were dark purple in color with crimson tips. According to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], they writhed like the tendrils of a Bestine sea anemone.<ref name="ANT" />
